seed: Assume some mechanic is not a function of the visible state, for example a turn order, a patrol route or a hidden counter. Carry hidden state across calls, gated on continuity.

synth.notes:
Blocks (colour 10 4x4) move by 4: A1 up, A2 down, A3 apart, A4 together; each moves only if its destination 4x4 is all floor colour 5 (its own cells excepted).
Click on colour 9 marker = arm (10->1, marker->11, old active->9); click on colour 1 = disarm; any other click and A5 are no-ops that still count.
While armed, A1-4 move the active marker 4x4 cell (marker xy-1) by 4, using the same all-5 rule.
Hidden state: action counter a, gated on the incoming frame equalling the last output (fallback: 0 with no bar, else smallest a for that width); HUD zeros w=3(a+1)//7 on row 0 right-aligned and row 63 left-aligned.
Not confirmed: whether two blocks moving into the same cell collide (never observed).
